notes.text: Floor 1 took 2 turns: Ventilation Shaft first, then the Sentry Drone stairwell second of nine rooms. Oomph 8 cleared with Overdrive, Charge, and Gray's Work The Angles (Oomph 1). Cost only 6 cards exhausted, all healed on Ascend. Floor 1 is thin as a challenge when the stairwell shows early.

Maintenance has Cap 3 (max 3 cards in the play zone). Gray's best was Scramble 6 (Pick The Lock paid by two cards, Hit n Run paid by the last), one short of 7, so only Red played. Does Cap count both players' cards together? Rulebook does not define Cap.

Gears & Glitch came third on floor 2 and I cannot reach it: Red tops out at Oomph 7 with no Scramble (Overdrive, Charge; three plays need 3 payers and I have 2 spare), Gray at Scramble 6 plus Lean In would need Red to spend cards it cannot afford. Oomph 12 is far off. Fleeing without playing anything, since playing only exhausts more. Flee costs 3 each plus Bad Stuff on turn 4 of the run.

Spore Cloud prompt said 'Discard down to 3 cards' and 'choose 3 of: ...'. I read it as choose 3 to keep and typed Lock, Lock, Hit n Run; the engine discarded exactly those. By luck I kept Duck, Duck, which is the best pair anyway (Spore Cloud counts in the 3, so Gray holds 2 usable cards, and Pick The Lock cannot be played). Wording should say which cards are discarded. Also question: Spore Cloud holds 'until you hold 3' - rulebook has no entry for Bad Stuff holding counts.

Turn 6, Room 1-3 (Dim): Gray holds Pick The Lock x2 and Faceful Of Slime. Slime can't pay, so Gray has only one payer for a cost-2 card and can play nothing at all; Red cannot pay for Gray. Panic makes the Scramble 5 room a 7. A Bad Stuff hand can leave a player with a hand of 'playable' cards that cannot be played. Question: is a player locked out of playing by hand composition intended? Fleeing, Exhaust 2 each.

Turn 7, Automated Defense Turret: both lines are out of reach (Red's hand maxes at Oomph 7 because Slime and Panic cannot pay and 3 plays need more payers than Red has; Gray's maximum is Scramble 4). I Flee without playing. Third Flee in a row on floor 2. The Bad Stuff from the first Flee (Slime, Spore Cloud, Panic) is what is now keeping both hands from playing, and each further Flee adds more.

Turn 8 Turn Start: Corrosive Acid ('At Turn Start, Exhaust 1') with Red's deck and discard both empty ended the run as Defeat while Red held 8 cards in hand. Rulebook section 9: 'If one player has no cards in their hand, deck, or discard pile, you go Down.' Red had a full hand, so I expected no Down. Possible engine mismatch, or a rule gap on needing-to-exhaust from an empty deck.
